// ============================================================================

// Protect - Sequencer (Pipeline Version + PSEUDO "Move to Front" + Return + Conditional Flip)

//

// Change requested:

// ✅ Everything that's NOT VFX/SFX is now handled via ONI Pseudo Animation

// - Caster moves to "front of target" using pseudo clone (X + Y)

// - Optional flip happens on the pseudo clone AFTER arriving, then flips back AFTER returning

// - No token document movement, so snap guarantee removed

//

// VFX/SFX still done by Sequencer:

// - Protect FX + sound

//

// UPDATE NOTE:

// Your header says "Protect FX scale = 1"

// Your code uses .scale(0.3) with a comment "requested scaling"

// I preserved your ACTUAL code behavior: scale(0.3).

// If you want scale(1), change that one line.

//

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[Protect]";

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

// --- Require ONI Pseudo Animation API ---

if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation API not found (game.ONI.pseudo.play).");

console.error(TAG, "Missing game.ONI.pseudo.play");

return;

}

// Minimal ONI.emit helper

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// --- Payload ---

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

// --- Helpers ---

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

function pickTargetsFromPayload(p) {

if (Array.isArray(p.targetTokenIds) && p.targetTokenIds.length) return p.targetTokenIds;

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

if (typeof t === "string") out.push(t);

else if (t?.tokenId) out.push(t.tokenId);

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

return out.filter(Boolean);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

}

if (out.length) return out;

}

return [];

}

// --- Resolve caster & targets ---

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

// Fallbacks for testing

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const fallbackTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

const sourceToken = (await resolveToken(sourceRef)) ?? fallbackSource;

const targets = [];

for (const r of targetRefs) {

const tok = await resolveToken(r);

if (tok) targets.push(tok);

}

if (!targets.length && fallbackTargets.length) targets.push(...fallbackTargets);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("Protect: No caster token (payload missing and nothing selected).");

return;

}

if (!targets.length) {

ui.notifications.warn("Protect: No targets (payload missing and nothing targeted).");

return;

}

// Single-target

const targetToken = targets[0];

// --- Dispositions ---

const casterDisposition =

sourceToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

sourceToken?.document?.disposition ??

0;

const targetDisposition =

targetToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

targetToken?.document?.disposition ??

0;

const casterHostile = casterDisposition === -1;

const targetHostile = targetDisposition === -1;

// --- "Front of target" (JRPG side rule) ---

// Target hostile (-1) is on LEFT and faces RIGHT => front is RIGHT of target

// Target friendly (not -1) is on RIGHT and faces LEFT => front is LEFT of target

const frontIsRightOfTarget = targetHostile;

// --- Movement (X + Y, fast) ---

const squares = 0.60; // tweak

const offsetPx = canvas.grid.size * squares;

const destFront = {

x: targetToken.document.x + (frontIsRightOfTarget ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx),

y: targetToken.document.y,

};

const moveOutMs = 220;

const moveBackMs = 220;

// --- Conditional flip rule ---

// "friendly unit protect a hostile target" => caster friendly AND target hostile AND differ

const shouldFlipCaster =

(casterDisposition !== -1) && (targetDisposition === -1) && (casterDisposition !== targetDisposition);

// Mirror state of the REAL token (for reference / logging only)

const originalMirrorX = sourceToken.document.mirrorX ?? false;

// --- Broadcast start ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "skillProtect",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

meta: { casterHostile, targetHostile, frontIsRightOfTarget, shouldFlipCaster },

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// --- Assets ---

const FX_PROTECT =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Conditions/Boon01/ConditionBoon01_012_Green_600x600.webm";

const SFX_PROTECT = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Shield2.wav";

// --- PSEUDO: move to front -> (optional flip) -> hold -> move back -> (optional unflip) ---

// Hold should cover: FX start + your scripted wait(2000) + moveBack time window.

// We'll keep pseudo "holding in front" for exactly 2000ms (your original hold),

// and Sequencer will time its VFX so it plays while the pseudo clone is in front.

const holdMs = 2000;

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function animate(obj, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = fromX + (toX - fromX) * e;

obj.y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * e;

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

sprite.zIndex = 5000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

const toX = Number(params.toX);

const toY = Number(params.toY);

const moveOutMs = Number(params.moveOutMs ?? 220);

const holdMs = Number(params.holdMs ?? 0);

const moveBackMs = Number(params.moveBackMs ?? 220);

const shouldFlip = Boolean(params.shouldFlip ?? false);

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

// Hide real token locally (once)

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

const homeX = sprite.x, homeY = sprite.y;

// Move OUT (X + Y)

await animate(sprite, homeX, homeY, toX, toY, moveOutMs);

// Flip AFTER arriving (only on pseudo clone)

if (shouldFlip) sprite.scale.x = -Math.abs(sprite.scale.x);

// Hold in front

if (holdMs > 0) await wait(holdMs);

// Flip back BEFORE returning (so return looks normal)

if (shouldFlip) sprite.scale.x = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x);

// Move BACK

await animate(sprite, toX, toY, homeX, homeY, moveBackMs);

} finally {

if (sprite) { canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite); sprite.destroy(); }

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

// Convert destFront token-doc coords -> stage (center) coords for the sprite.

// Token center = document x/y + (w/2,h/2) grid pixels

const wPx = (sourceToken.document.width ?? 1) * canvas.grid.size;

const hPx = (sourceToken.document.height ?? 1) * canvas.grid.size;

const frontCenterX = destFront.x + wPx / 2;

const frontCenterY = destFront.y + hPx / 2;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.protect.moveToFrontHoldReturn",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [targetToken.document.uuid],

params: {

toX: frontCenterX,

toY: frontCenterY,

moveOutMs,

holdMs,

moveBackMs,

shouldFlip: shouldFlipCaster,

},

meta: { source: "Protect", shouldFlipCaster, originalMirrorX },

});

// --- MAIN SEQUENCE (VFX/SFX only) ---

const seq = new Sequence();

// Wait until pseudo arrival completes, then play FX/SFX (matches original "after arriving")

seq.wait(moveOutMs);

// FX on target + sound

seq.sound()

.file(SFX_PROTECT)

.volume(0.95);

seq.effect()

.file(FX_PROTECT)

.atLocation(targetToken)

.scale(0.3) // ⬅ preserved from your code; change to 1.0 if you want header behavior

.opacity(1.0);

// Hold (same as your original)

seq.wait(holdMs);

// Wait the remainder of pseudo return time so animationEnd happens after everything is done

seq.wait(moveBackMs);

await seq.play();

// --- Broadcast end ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "skillProtect",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END", { moveOutMs, holdMs, moveBackMs, shouldFlipCaster });

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

// Still emit animationEnd so pipeline won't hang

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "skillProtect", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

);

} catch (_) {}

}

})();

// --- Helpers ---

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

if (!ref) return null;

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const out = [];

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

if (out.length) return out;

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

0;

targetToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

targetToken?.document?.disposition ??

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "skillMuleta",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

meta: { casterDisposition, targetDisposition, mirrorX, frontIsRightOfTarget },

{ local: true, world: false }

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Template/Line/Generic/Piercing_Generic01_01_Regular_Orange_1000x400.webm";

// --- Broadcast end ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "skillMuleta",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END");

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "skillMuleta", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

// ============================================================================

// Descabello - Custom Logic Action

// Adds:

// 1) Half caster level as bonus damage, rounded up.

// 2) Skill Enhancement bonus based on caster level:

// Lv. 20+ = base damage becomes 40, so add +10.

// Lv. 40+ = base damage becomes 50, so add +20.

//

// IMPORTANT:

// Keep the skill's normal Damage Bonus field at 30 on the sheet.

// This script adds the enhancement difference as bonus damage.

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][DESCABELLO]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

p.meta = p.meta || {};

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 1) Resolve caster / attacker

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const attackerUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerActorUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

"";

if (!attackerUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing attacker UUID.", { payload: p });

return;

}

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve attacker actor.", { attackerUuid });

return;

}

const props = attackerActor.system?.props ?? {};

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 2) Read caster level

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Tries several possible level keys, so this is safer if your sheet name changes.

const levelCandidates = [

props.level,

props.current_level,

props.character_level,

props.lv,

props.Level

];

let casterLevel = 0;

for (const raw of levelCandidates) {

const n = Number(raw);

if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) {

casterLevel = n;

break;

}

}

if (!casterLevel) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not detect caster level. No bonus applied.", {

actor: attackerActor.name,

checkedKeys: ["level", "current_level", "character_level", "lv", "Level"]

});

return;

}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 3) Calculate bonus damage

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const halfLevelBonus = Math.ceil(casterLevel / 2);

let enhancementBonus = 0;

let enhancementTier = "None";

if (casterLevel >= 40) {

enhancementBonus = 20; // 30 -> 50

enhancementTier = "Lv. 40 Enhancement";

} else if (casterLevel >= 20) {

enhancementBonus = 10; // 30 -> 40

enhancementTier = "Lv. 20 Enhancement";

}

const totalBonus = halfLevelBonus + enhancementBonus;

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 4) Apply to advPayload.bonus

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const beforeBonus = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = beforeBonus + totalBonus;

// Optional debug info saved into payload meta.

p.meta.descabello = {

casterLevel,

halfLevelBonus,

enhancementTier,

enhancementBonus,

totalBonus,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

};

console.log(TAG, "Applied Descabello bonus damage.", {

caster: attackerActor.name,

casterLevel,

halfLevelBonus,

enhancementTier,

enhancementBonus,

totalBonus,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});

})();

log("CANCEL @ step1: event did not target owner.", {

key,

ownerTokenUuid: ownerInfo?.ownerTokenUuid ?? null,

ownerActorUuid: ownerInfo?.ownerActorUuid ?? null,

eventTargetUuid: evt?.targetUuid ?? null,

eventTargets: Array.isArray(evt?.targets) ? evt.targets : []

});

return { ok: false, reason: "not_targeting_owner" };

}

return { ok: true };

}

async function step2_CheckEnemySource(ownerInfo) {

const source = await getSourceActorAndToken();

const ownerDisp = getDisposition(ownerInfo?.token ?? ownerInfo?.actor);

const sourceDisp = getDisposition(source?.token ?? source?.actor);

log("Step2 source/owner disposition", {

ownerName: ownerInfo?.actor?.name ?? ownerInfo?.token?.name ?? null,

sourceName: source?.actor?.name ?? source?.token?.name ?? null,

ownerDisp,

sourceDisp

});

// If source is clearly same-side friendly, block.

if (source?.actor && ownerInfo?.actor) {

if (source.actor.uuid === ownerInfo.actor.uuid) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("source_is_self", { notify: false });

log("CANCEL @ step2: source is self.");

return { ok: false, reason: "source_is_self" };

}

}

if (sourceDisp !== 0 && ownerDisp !== 0 && isSameSide(ownerDisp, sourceDisp)) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("source_is_ally", { notify: false });

log("CANCEL @ step2: source is ally / same side.");

return { ok: false, reason: "source_is_ally" };

}

return { ok: true };

}

async function step3_HandleMiss(ownerInfo) {

const actor = ownerInfo?.actor;

if (!actor) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("no_owner_actor", { notify: false });

warn("CANCEL @ miss: no owner actor.");

return { ok: false, reason: "no_owner_actor" };

}

const cur = getActorAdoration(actor);

const next = clamp(cur + ADORATION_GAIN_ON_MISS, 0, 5);

const ok = await setActorAdoration(actor, next);

log(`MISS: +${ADORATION_GAIN_ON_MISS} Adoration`, {

cur,

next,

updated: ok,

owner: actor?.name ?? null

});

await showPassiveCard({

title: `Pases: Adoration +${ADORATION_GAIN_ON_MISS}`,

icon: "🌹",

anchorTokenUuid: ownerInfo?.ownerTokenUuid ?? null

});

ctx.skipPassive?.("miss_increment_adoration", { notify: false });

return { ok: false, reason: "miss_increment_adoration" };

}

async function step4_CheckPositiveDamage() {

const { key, evt } = getPhaseEvent();

const evtFinal = num(evt?.finalValue, null);

const evtAffected = (evt?.affected === true);

const evtNoEffect = str(evt?.noEffectReason).toLowerCase();

if (key === "creature_takes_damage") {

if (evtFinal !== null) {

log("Step4 damage event.finalValue", {

evtFinal,

evtAffected,

evtNoEffect

});

if (evtFinal > 0) {

return { ok: true, estimate: evtFinal, via: "event.finalValue" };

}

ctx.skipPassive?.("no_damage_after_reduction", { notify: false });

log("CANCEL @ step4: finalValue <= 0.");

return { ok: false, reason: "no_damage" };

}

}

const estimate = computeFinalDamageEstimate();

log("Step4 fallback estimate", { estimate, advPayload: payload?.advPayload ?? null });

if (estimate <= 0) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("no_damage_after_reduction", { notify: false });

log("CANCEL @ step4: estimate <= 0.");

return { ok: false, reason: "no_damage" };

}

return { ok: true, estimate, via: "estimate" };

}

async function step5_ResetAdorationOnDamage(ownerInfo) {

const actor = ownerInfo?.actor;

if (!actor) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("no_owner_actor", { notify: false });

warn("CANCEL @ reset: no owner actor.");

return { ok: false, reason: "no_owner_actor" };

}

const ok = await setActorAdoration(actor, 0);

log("TAKES DAMAGE: reset Adoration to 0", {

updated: ok,

owner: actor?.name ?? null

});

ctx.skipPassive?.("hit_reset_adoration", { notify: false });

return { ok };

}

async function stepFallback_CompareAccuracy(ownerInfo) {

const chosen = chooseDefenseToUse();

const defVal = readOwnerDefense(payload?.meta?.defenseSnapshot, chosen);

const acc = readAccuracyTotal();

if (acc == null) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("accuracy_unknown", { notify: false });

warn("CANCEL @ fallback compare: accuracy total unknown.", { defVal });

return { ok: false, reason: "accuracy_unknown" };

}

const isHit = acc >= defVal;

log("Fallback compare result", {

accuracyTotal: acc,

defenseUsed: defVal,

isHit

});

if (!isHit) {

return await step3_HandleMiss(ownerInfo);

}

const dmg = await step4_CheckPositiveDamage();

if (!dmg.ok) return dmg;

return await step5_ResetAdorationOnDamage(ownerInfo);

}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Execution

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(async () => {

if (!ctx?.isPassiveExecution) {

log("Non-passive execution; skipping Pases logic.");

return;

}

const ownerInfo = await getOwnerActorAndToken();

if (!ownerInfo?.ownerActorUuid && !ownerInfo?.ownerTokenUuid) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("no_owner_identity", { notify: false });

warn("CANCEL: could not resolve passive owner.", {

passiveItemUuid: payload?.meta?.passiveItemUuid ?? payload?.skillUuid ?? null,

attackerUuid: payload?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? payload?.attackerUuid ?? null

});

return;

}

const { key, evt } = getPhaseEvent();

log("BEGIN", {

passiveTriggerKey: key,

ownerTokenUuid: ownerInfo?.ownerTokenUuid ?? null,

ownerActorUuid: ownerInfo?.ownerActorUuid ?? null,

ownerName: ownerInfo?.actor?.name ?? ownerInfo?.token?.name ?? null,

eventPreview: {

kind: evt?.kind ?? null,

targetUuid: evt?.targetUuid ?? null,

targets: Array.isArray(evt?.targets) ? evt.targets : [],

attackerUuid: evt?.attackerUuid ?? null,

sourceUuid: evt?.sourceUuid ?? null,

finalValue: evt?.finalValue ?? null,

affected: evt?.affected ?? null,

noEffectReason: evt?.noEffectReason ?? null

}

});

const s1 = await step1_CheckOwnerWasTargeted(ownerInfo);

if (!s1.ok) return;

const s2 = await step2_CheckEnemySource(ownerInfo);

if (!s2.ok) return;

// Primary intended triggers

if (key === "creature_miss_action") {

await step3_HandleMiss(ownerInfo);

return;

}

if (key === "creature_takes_damage") {

const s4 = await step4_CheckPositiveDamage();

if (!s4.ok) return;

await step5_ResetAdorationOnDamage(ownerInfo);

return;

}

// Safety fallback for older / partial trigger setups

log("Using fallback compare path for unexpected trigger.", { key });

await stepFallback_CompareAccuracy(ownerInfo);

})();
